lines.say: One chat. A company of AI employees, working in a fixed order.
The Project Manager plans the whole launch for VYRA.
Logo draws nine ideas. You pick one.
Brand Kit builds the full look.
Portrait turns a selfie into a studio shot.
YouTube, Long Video and Thumbnail run the channel.
X, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook get their posts.
Ads drafts the campaign. And nothing spends until you approve.
Fifty-two AI employees. One chat. Amy.
